What TaskUs sells

  • AI & Data Operations: People collect and label data. Experts also write responses for model training.
  • AI Safety & Alignment: Red teaming (deliberate attacks that reveal model weaknesses) and human feedback support safer model behavior.
  • Digital customer experience and Trust & Safety: Outsourced customer support, plus review of content and financial crime.
  • TaskVerse: Gig workers collect and label data for projects.
  • Data Feedback & Evaluations: Experts review responses and design tests of model performance.
  • TaskGPT: A generative AI platform that powers TaskUs tools for customer-support teams.
